title: Protein-derived cofactors: chemical innovations expanding enzyme catalysis
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2025, 54,4502-4530
DOI: 10.1039/D4CS00981A, Review Article
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Angelica Graciano, Aimin Liu
Protein-derived cofactors, formed through posttranslational modification of a single amino acid or covalent crosslinking of amino acid side chains, represent a rapidly expanding class of catalytic moieties that redefine enzyme functionality.
